sample_unit: randomly selected ICD code descriptions (100 each from ICD-9-CM, ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS), each prompted to both models

links.outcome: Exact-match accuracy of LLM-generated ICD billing codes against official codes
links.effect: ICD-9-CM exact match GPT-4 22%, GPT-3.5 10%; ICD-10-CM 13% and 10%; ICD-10-PCS 0% for both models. Incorrect codes often semantically similar but with hallucinated details.
links.quote: While the models appear to exhibit a general conceptual understanding of the codes and their descriptions, they have a propensity for hallucinating key details, suggesting underlying technological limitations of the base LLMs.

screen.reason: Evaluates base performance of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 on an administrative healthcare benchmark task (generating ICD billing codes) without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
